userStories.title: Update repo add command for universal git URLs

acceptanceCriteria: sm repo add accepts HTTPS URLs from any domain

userStories.title: Add sm subagents CLI command group

userStories.title: Add integration tests for universal git sources
userStories.description: As a developer, I want integration tests covering various git sources so that the feature is validated

userStories.title: Fix sm add error message for non-GitHub URLs
userStories.description: As a user, I want sm add to accept GitLab/Bitbucket URLs so that I can add repositories from any git source
acceptanceCriteria: sm add accepts GitLab URLs without GitHub-specific error
Error messages reference universal git support, not just github.com

userStories.title: Fix sm upgrade for repos cloned before universal git support
userStories.description: As a user, I want sm upgrade to work for all my repos so that I can update repositories regardless of when they were added
acceptanceCriteria: sm upgrade works for repos at legacy cache paths (git/{owner}/{repo})
userStories.notes: Fixed: Added resolve_repo_cache_path() that checks both new-style (git/{host}/{owner}/{repo}) and legacy (git/{owner}/{repo}) paths. Updated upgrade_with_lock() and pin() to use this function. 85 tests pass.

userStories.title: Fix agent symlinks not created in ~/.claude/agents/
userStories.description: As a user, I want enabled agents to be symlinked so that they are available in my coding environment
acceptanceCriteria: Built-in integrations auto-populate agents_dir when missing

userStories.title: Fix interactive mode not showing skills from legacy cache paths

acceptanceCriteria: Interactive mode shows all skills regardless of cache path structure
Skills from pre-universal-git repos appear in list
userStories.notes: Fixed: Updated manage() to use paths::resolve_repo_cache_path() which checks both new-style and legacy cache paths.

userStories.title: Improve sm repo ls output with skill and agent counts
userStories.description: As a user, I want sm repo ls to show clear skill and agent counts so that I understand what each repository contains
acceptanceCriteria: sm repo ls shows separate SKILLS and AGENTS columns
userStories.notes: Implemented: Updated list() in repo.rs to show SKILLS and AGENTS columns with enabled/total ratio format. Removed TOTAL, ENABLED, DISABLED columns. 89 tests pass.

userStories.title: Fix inconsistent -a flag behavior across commands
userStories.description: As a user, I want -a to consistently mean --all so that CLI flags are predictable
acceptanceCriteria: Use different short flag for --agents filter (e.g., -g or -t)
userStories.notes: Fixed: Changed -a to mean --all in sm list, changed --agents short flag to -g. Now consistent: sm list -a, sm skills list -a, sm subagents list -a all show all items.

userStories.title: Fix broken symlinks when re-enabling skills
userStories.description: As a user, I want re-enabled skills to work so that toggling skills doesn't break them
acceptanceCriteria: Re-enabling skill creates working symlink to actual cache location
Symlinks point to correct path regardless of when repo was cloned
userStories.notes: Fixed: Changed enable_with_lock() in both skill.rs and subagent.rs to use resolve_repo_cache_path() instead of repo_cache_path(). This ensures symlinks point to the correct cache location for repos cloned before universal git support.

userStories.title: Add git source type indicator to sm repo ls
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see the git source type so that I know how each repository will be fetched
acceptanceCriteria: sm repo ls shows source type indicator ([https], [ssh], [local])
Or shows actual URL used for git operations
userStories.notes: Implemented in commit b613439 - added url_to_source_type() helper function that detects source type from stored URL. Added SOURCE column to sm repo ls output showing [https], [ssh], or [local]. Added 3 unit tests. 95 total tests pass.

userStories.title: Fix sm list --skills --agents showing no results
userStories.description: As a user, I want combined filters to work so that I can view both skills and agents when requested
acceptanceCriteria: sm list --skills --agents shows both (same as no filter)
Or throw error saying flags are mutually exclusive
